summary: Triller Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its wholly owned subsidiary Trendy Reach Holdings Limited entered a definitive purchase agreement to acquire 100% of the membership interests of SAC1 Holdings for $411.3M, equivalent to $105 per share equivalent. The consideration is cash, with closing expected by July 22, 2026. The target holds common stock equivalents in SpaceX Shares. The board's recommendation is not mentioned; no advisors named. The purchase price will be held in escrow until transfer documentation is finalized. Closing conditions include funding and satisfactory due diligence. Watch for regulatory and transfer timing; risk-arb centers on SpaceX valuation and escrow release mechanics.
